title: Coefficient normalization of the raw ordered completed exchange
statement:
Fix a cartesian square of schemes $\square=(f:X\to Y,f':X'\to Y',g:Y'\to Y,g':X'\to X)$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], and the adic datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]: $A$ is commutative Noetherian, $I$ is finitely generated, $A/I$ is additive torsion, and every $P_n=A/I^n$ is finite and perfect over $A$. Put $A_T=\varprojlim_n\underline{P_n}_T$ on the small pro-etale site of each corner $T$, with the canonical map $\underline A_T\to A_T$. Let $\operatorname{Res}_T$ be derived restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Use the canonical coefficient isomorphisms $u^{-1}A_V\cong A_U$ [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image] and the ringed operations over $A_T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the strict reduction tower functor $\mathcal R^a_T$ of the datum, and completed pullback $F^a_u$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$, with $\mathcal L_T=R\lim$ on its derived category and strict constant-coefficient reduction functor $\mathcal R_T$ as in [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. For an edge $u:U\to V$, write $G_u=u^{-1}$ termwise, $R_u^{\mathcal T}$ for derived termwise direct image, $R_u^0=Ru_*$ on constant-coefficient complexes, $C_T=\mathcal L_T\mathcal R_T$, and $F_u^0=C_UG_u$ on the full derived-complete categories [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction]. All sites and diagram sites are small in the convention of [def-weil-size-convention].

Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ be any derived $I$-complete object, meaning that the canonical quotient completion map $K\to\mathcal L^a_X\mathcal R^a_XK$ is invertible [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction], and put $\bar K=\operatorname{Res}_XK$. No properness, constructibility, boundedness, or etale-origin hypothesis is imposed. Use derived strict-tower operations $\mathscr L_u,\mathscr R_u$ over $A_T$, computed on the diagram sites [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Define the raw ordered construction as follows, before choosing any finite etale-origin witnesses. Put $E=Lg'^*K$, $M=Lg^*Rf_*K$, $N=Rf'_*E$, and let $e:M\to N$ be the ambient ringed adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let
$$B^a=\mathscr L_g\mathscr R_f\mathcal R^a_XK,\qquad D^a=\mathscr R_{f'}\mathscr L_{g'}\mathcal R^a_XK.$$
Let $H^a:\mathcal R^a_{Y'}M\xrightarrow{\sim}B^a$ and $H'^a:\mathcal R^a_{Y'}N\xrightarrow{\sim}D^a$ be the diagram-site projection-formula maps (adjuncts of counit tensored with identity [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map]), with the canonical derived pullback/tensor isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] on these ringed diagram sites, using the coefficient identifications $u^{-1}\underline{P_n}_V\cong\underline{P_n}_U$ and $u^{-1}A_V\cong A_U$ fixed above. Their inverses exist by perfection of the $P_n$. Set
$$v^a=H'^a\mathcal R^a_{Y'}(e)(H^a)^{-1},\qquad s^a=\mathcal L^a(H^a)r_S,\qquad c^a:Rf'_*F^a_{g'}K\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L^aD^a,$$
where $\mathcal L^a$ is derived strict inverse limit with completed coefficients [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality], $r_S:F^a_gRf_*K\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L^a\mathcal R^a_{Y'}M$ is the quotient reconstruction identification of completed pullback, and $c^a$ is the specified direct-image/limit comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Put $x^a_K=(c^a)^{-1}\mathcal L^a(v^a)s^a$.

The following comparisons and equations hold in the derived strict-tower categories and derived module categories, naturally for all morphisms of complete $K$.

(1) Restriction commutes canonically with derived direct image on ambient complexes:
$$\chi_u:\operatorname{Res}_VRu_*\xrightarrow{\sim}R_u^0\operatorname{Res}_U.$$
On complete objects it identifies the completed adjunctions, with their units and counits, under the equivalences of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]:
$$\phi_u:\operatorname{Res}_UF^a_u\xrightarrow{\sim}F_u^0\operatorname{Res}_V.$$
Here $F^a_u\dashv Ru_*$ is the adjunction induced by ordinary module pullback/direct image and the completion reflector; $\phi_u$ is the isomorphism respecting their hom-set bijections and completion units. In particular these comparisons identify the canonical composition and identity comparisons defined as adjunction conjugates [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] of direct-image composition and identity. The equivalences do not identify the ambient constant and completed module categories.

(2) There is an isomorphism of actual derived strict towers
$$\rho_K:\operatorname{Res}_X\mathcal R^a_XK\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal R_X\bar K,$$
induced by derived tensor reassociation on the ringed diagram site and its single strict quotient diagram; it respects the quotient-tower unit. Put $B^0=G_gR_f^{\mathcal T}\mathcal R_X\bar K$, $D^0=R_{f'}^{\mathcal T}G_{g'}\mathcal R_X\bar K$. There are canonical tower isomorphisms
$$\beta:\operatorname{Res}_{Y'}B^a\xrightarrow{\sim}B^0,\qquad \delta:\operatorname{Res}_{Y'}D^a\xrightarrow{\sim}D^0.$$
Let $H^0:\mathcal R_{Y'}(G_gR_f^0\bar K)\to B^0$ be exactly the diagram projection-formula comparison in [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. There is a canonical isomorphism $\rho_M:\operatorname{Res}_{Y'}\mathcal R^a_{Y'}M\to\mathcal R_{Y'}(G_gR_f^0\bar K)$, obtained from the finite-reduction scalar comparisons, $\chi_f$, and derived pullback/tensor reassociation on that diagram site. They satisfy
$$\beta\operatorname{Res}(H^a)=H^0\rho_M,\qquad \delta\operatorname{Res}(v^a)=E^{\mathcal T}_{\mathcal R_X\bar K}\beta,$$
where $E^{\mathcal T}$ is the strict constant-coefficient adjunction mate of [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations]. In the witnessed proper situation of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization], these $\beta,\delta$ are its specified $b,d$ followed by the images of $\rho_K$. Its specified towers and witness-transported $v'_\bullet$ agree with $B^a,D^a,v^a$. Thus $x^a_K$ is exactly the ordered completed exchange of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] whenever the witnesses required there are provided, independently of their choice. Equality here is in the derived strict-tower category, not inferred from evaluations.

(3) Write $\lambda_Z:\operatorname{Res}\mathcal L^a Z\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L\operatorname{Res}Z$ for the canonical restriction/derived-limit comparison, computed on strict K-injective models. Let $s^0:F_g^0R_f^0\bar K\to\mathcal L B^0$ and $t^0:R_{f'}^0F_{g'}^0\bar K\to\mathcal L D^0$ be exactly $s,t$ of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. Put
$$\iota_S=(F_g^0\chi_f)\phi_g:\operatorname{Res}(F^a_gRf_*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}F_g^0R_f^0\bar K,\qquad \iota_T=(R_{f'}^0\phi_{g'})\chi_{f'}:\operatorname{Res}(Rf'_*F^a_{g'}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}R_{f'}^0F_{g'}^0\bar K.$$
Both reconstruction identifications and the direct-image comparison have the following fixed normalization:
$$\mathcal L(\rho_M)\lambda_{\mathcal R^a M}\operatorname{Res}(r_S)=r_S^0\iota_S,\qquad \mathcal L(\rho_{g',K})\lambda_{\mathscr L_{g'}\mathcal R^a K}\operatorname{Res}(r_{g',K})=r_{g',K}^0\phi_{g'},$$
where $r_{g',K}:F^a_{g'}K\to\mathcal L^a(\mathscr L_{g'}\mathcal R^a_XK)$ is the defining reconstruction, $r_{g',K}^0:F_{g'}^0\bar K\to\mathcal L G_{g'}\mathcal R_X\bar K$ is its constant-coefficient counterpart, and $\rho_{g',K}:\operatorname{Res}\mathscr L_{g'}\mathcal R^a_XK\to G_{g'}\mathcal R_X\bar K$ is the same diagram-site finite-reduction scalar comparison. Here $r_S^0$ is the source reconstruction in the definition of $s^0$. Consequently
$$\mathcal L(\beta)\lambda_{B^a}\operatorname{Res}(s^a)=s^0\iota_S,\qquad \mathcal L(\delta)\lambda_{D^a}\operatorname{Res}(c^a)=t^0\iota_T.$$
In particular the equation for the raw ordered exchange is
$$\iota_T\operatorname{Res}(x^a_K)= (t^0)^{-1}\mathcal L(E^{\mathcal T}_{\mathcal R_X\bar K})s^0\iota_S.$$
All displayed comparisons are the specified scalar, projection-formula, completion-unit and direct-image/limit comparisons. The equations are natural-transformation equations on the full derived-complete category, valid without witnesses also at complete inputs obtained by completed pullback or derived direct image. No identity-square or pasting law for exchange is asserted here.
